title: Out-of-Network Reimbursement Amounts, Vision Plans
content:
When a Vision Plans member receives care from a provider without a Cascade agreement, the member is reimbursed up to the out-of-network amounts below (USD, the most reimbursed for each service).

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine exam | 40.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 |
| Frame | 0.00 | 50.00 | 65.00 | 70.00 | 80.00 | 100.00 |
| Single-vision lenses | 0.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 35.00 | 40.00 | 45.00 |
| Lined bifocal lenses | 0.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 | 65.00 |
| Lined trifocal lenses | 0.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 | 70.00 | 80.00 | 85.00 |
| Progressive lenses (standard or premium) | 0.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 | 85.00 |
| Elective contact lenses | 0.00 | 85.00 | 105.00 | 105.00 | 120.00 | 150.00 |
| Medically necessary contact lenses | 0.00 | 210.00 | 210.00 | 210.00 | 210.00 | 210.00 |
| Lens options reimbursed out of network | No | No | No | No | No | No |

**About the amounts**

- Each figure is the most reimbursed to the member for that out-of-network service.
- The frame amount is 0.00 where frames are not covered, which is why Cascade Vision Exam Plus shows 0.00 for every service except the routine exam.
- "No" on the last row means lens options get no out-of-network reimbursement; that is the case on every plan.
- Progressive lenses of either kind share the one progressive amount.
